name: University of Toledo
tuition_note: In-state (Ohio resident) full-time undergraduate tuition & fees 2026-27 (2026 cohort, Tuition Guarantee): $6,450.36/semester x 2 = $12,900.72/year, from utoledo.edu/offices/treasurer/tuition/undergraduate/. Housing room only from utoledo.edu/offices/treasurer/housingandmealplans/: McComas Village room-only 2026 cohort $3,921/semester x 2 = $7,842/year (no meal plan required; page last updated 7/28/26). Most other residence halls are billed room+board combined.
